require 'async'
require 'async/http'
require 'async/http/endpoint'
require 'cgi'
require 'openssl'
require 'socket'
require 'uri'

require 'fluent/plugin_helper/http_server/app'
require 'fluent/plugin_helper/http_server/router'
require 'fluent/plugin_helper/http_server/methods'
require 'fluent/log/console_adapter'
require 'fluent/tls'

module Fluent
  module PluginHelper
    module HttpServer
      class Server
        PreparedRequest = Struct.new(:path, :query_string, :raw) do
          def query
            query_string && CGI.parse(query_string)
          end

          def body
            raw && raw.body && raw.body.read
          end
        end

        def self.runtime
          @runtime ||= allocate.tap { |server| server.send(:prepare_runtime) }
        end

        def initialize(addr:, port:, logger:, default_app: nil, tls_context: nil)
          prepare_runtime
          configure_bind_address(addr)
          configure_bind_port(port)
          configure_lifecycle_logger(logger)
          configure_tls_context(tls_context)
          configure_route_registry(default_app)
          configure_dispatch_layer(logger)
          assemble_listen_uri(tls_scheme_name)
          assemble_reactor
          assemble_async_server
          if block_given?
            yield(self)
          end
        end

        def start(notify = nil)
          @bind_config[:status] = :starting
          log_listen_start
          task = run_listen_loop(notify)
          task.stop
          log_listen_finish
          @bind_config[:status] = :finished
          task
        end

        def stop
          @bind_config[:status] = :stopping
          log_listen_close
          halt_reactor
          @bind_config[:status] = :stopped
        end

        HttpServer::Methods::ALL.map { |e| e.downcase.to_sym }.each do |name|
          define_method(name) do |path, app = nil, &block|
            unless path.end_with?('/')
              path << '/'
            end

            if (block && app) || (!block && !app)
              raise 'You must specify either app or block in the same time'
            end

            @router.mount(name, path, app || block)
          end
        end

        def prepare_runtime
          reset_lifecycle_state
          reset_route_state
          reset_dispatch_state
          reset_tls_state
        end

        def reset_lifecycle_state
          @bind_config = {
            addr: nil,
            port: nil,
            uri: nil,
            logger: nil,
            reactor: nil,
            server: nil,
            scheme: 'http',
            status: :idle
          }
          @addr = nil
          @port = nil
          @uri = nil
          @logger = nil
          @reactor = nil
          @server = nil
        end

        def configure_bind_address(addr)
          host = normalize_listen_host(addr)
          mark_lifecycle(:binding)
          host
        end

        def configure_bind_port(port)
          value = normalize_listen_port(port)
          mark_lifecycle(:binding)
          value
        end

        def configure_lifecycle_logger(logger)
          @bind_config[:logger] = logger
          @logger = logger
          mark_lifecycle(:binding)
          lifecycle_logger
        end

        def assemble_listen_uri(scheme)
          host = @bind_config[:addr]
          port = @bind_config[:port]
          if host.nil? || host.to_s.empty?
            host = @addr
          end
          if port.nil?
            port = @port
          end
          @bind_config[:scheme] = scheme.nil? || scheme.to_s.empty? ? 'http' : scheme.to_s
          @uri = URI("#{@bind_config[:scheme]}://#{host}:#{port}").to_s
          @bind_config[:uri] = @uri
          @bind_config[:status] = :configured
          @uri
        end

        def assemble_reactor
          logger = @bind_config[:logger] || @logger
          @reactor = Async::Reactor.new(nil, logger: Fluent::Log::ConsoleAdapter.wrap(logger))
          @bind_config[:reactor] = @reactor
          @bind_config[:status] = :reactor_ready
          @reactor
        end

        def assemble_async_server
          app = current_http_app
          opts = tls_endpoint_options
          endpoint = parse_listen_endpoint(opts)
          @server = Async::HTTP::Server.new(app, endpoint)
          @bind_config[:server] = @server
          @bind_config[:status] = :server_ready
          @server
        end

        def parse_listen_endpoint(opts)
          uri = @bind_config[:uri] || @uri
          if opts.nil? || opts.empty?
            Async::HTTP::Endpoint.parse(uri)
          else
            Async::HTTP::Endpoint.parse(uri, **opts)

private_key_path = File.join(CERT_DIR, private_key)
          opt = { 'insecure' => 'false', 'private_key_path' => private_key_path, 'cert_path' => cert_path }

          on_driver_transport(opt) do |driver|
            driver.http_server_create_https_server(:http_server_helper_test_tls, addr: '127.0.0.1', port: @port, logger: NULL_LOGGER) do |s|
              s.get('/example/hello') { [200, { 'Content-Type' => 'text/plain' }, 'hello get'] }
            end

            resp = secure_get("https://127.0.0.1:#{@port}/example/hello", cert_path: cert_path)
            assert_equal('200', resp.code)
            assert_equal('hello get', resp.body)
          end
        end

        data(
          'with passphrase' => ['apple', 'cert-pass.pem', 'cert-key-pass.pem', 'ca-cert-pass.pem'],
          'without passphrase' => [nil, 'cert.pem', 'cert-key.pem', 'ca-cert.pem'])
        test 'load cert by private CA cert file, verified from clients using CA cert file' do |(passphrase, cert, cert_key, ca_cert)|
          omit "Self signed certificate blocks TLS connection. Need to debug." if Fluent.windows?

          cert_path = File.join(CERT_CA_DIR, cert)
          private_key_path = File.join(CERT_CA_DIR, cert_key)

          ca_cert_path = File.join(CERT_CA_DIR, ca_cert)

          opt = { 'insecure' => 'false', 'cert_path' => cert_path, 'private_key_path' => private_key_path }
          if passphrase
            opt['private_key_passphrase'] = passphrase
          end

          on_driver_transport(opt) do |driver|
            driver.http_server_create_https_server(:http_server_helper_test_tls, addr: '127.0.0.1', port: @port, logger: NULL_LOGGER) do |s|
              s.get('/example/hello') { [200, { 'Content-Type' => 'text/plain' }, 'hello get'] }
            end

            resp = secure_get("https://127.0.0.1:#{@port}/example/hello", cert_path: ca_cert_path)
            assert_equal('200', resp.code)
            assert_equal('hello get', resp.body)
          end
        end
      end
    end

    test 'must be called #start and #stop' do
      on_driver do |driver|
        server = flexmock('Server') do |watcher|
          watcher.should_receive(:start).once.and_return do |que|
            que.push(:start)
          end
          watcher.should_receive(:stop).once
        end

        stub(Fluent::PluginHelper::HttpServer::Server).new(addr: anything, port: anything, logger: anything, default_app: anything) { server }
        driver.http_server_create_http_server(:http_server_helper_test, addr: '127.0.0.1', port: @port, logger: NULL_LOGGER) do
          # nothing
        end
        driver.stop
      end
    end
  end
end
